先在纸上写清楚目的：需要开车，还是需要一张便于日常出示的身份证明？接着写下现有证: Start by writing down your goal: do you need to drive, or do you need ID for everyday use? Then note where your existing documents were issued, whether they're valid, and which card you want. Keeping these three questions separate helps you avoid following a friend's old checklist into the wrong process. This guide focuses on adults preparing to apply; minors should check DMV's age and training requirements separately.
驾驶资格、ID 和 REAL ID 是不同的问题: Driving privileges, ID cards, and REAL ID are separate questions
DMV 的 ID Cards 页面说明：ID 可证明身份或年龄，但不能让你驾驶车: DMV's ID Cards page explains that an ID proves identity or age but does not authorize driving. To drive, check the Driver's Licenses process. For identification only, compare a standard ID with REAL ID. REAL ID serves federal identification purposes; it does not waive driving-license tests. Also consider other acceptable documents you already have rather than applying simply because others did.
按原有驾照分流，不把外国驾照当成外州驾照: Follow the process for your existing license; a foreign license is not an out-of-state license

已有有效美国其他州驾照：查看外州驾照申请章节，准备申请、身份住址材料、视力与知识: Valid license from another U.S. state: Review the out-of-state application section and prepare for the application, identity and address documents, vision screening, knowledge testing, and other steps. DMV determines the specific testing requirements.
已有外国驾照：DMV 另列此类申请，并要求通过驾驶考试；不要默认可以直接换证。: If you hold a foreign driver's license, DMV lists a separate application situation and requires a driving test. Don't assume you can simply exchange it.
只办 ID：按 ID 页面准备到场核验、拍照等流程，不需要为身份证明卡安排驾驶考: ID only: Follow the ID page for in-person verification, photos, and related steps. You do not need a driving test for an identification card.
去 DMV 官网的 Driver’s Licenses 页面选中与你相符的章节，: On DMV's Driver's Licenses page, choose the section that matches your situation before applying or booking an appointment. Existing California license holders renewing, replacing a card, or updating an address should choose that service rather than starting a first-time application. Whether you may drive while applying must be checked against your residency, documents, and permit conditions.
新居民驾照：10 天涉及驾驶豁免，不是预约宽限: New-resident driving: the 10 days limit an exemption, not an appointment grace period
2026-10-04 核对：California Vehicle Code 12: Checked October 4, 2026: Vehicle Code 12505(c) limits an otherwise eligible nonresident-license exemption to at most 10 days after establishing California residency. Driving for employment after becoming a resident requires a California license first. Applying or booking an appointment within 10 days does not extend permission to drive indefinitely on an out-of-state license. Residency depends on domicile and evidence of settling, rather than automatically starting on every visitor’s arrival date. Confirm an uncertain start date with DMV and begin the application promptly.
外州驾照换州：先准备申请与材料: Transferring an out-of-state license: application and documents
持有效美国外州驾照的成年人，从 DMV Driver’s Licenses 的外: Adults with a valid license from another U.S. state should use the out-of-state section of DMV’s Driver’s Licenses page. Prepare your SSN, an accepted original or certified identity document, residency documents for a first California DL/ID, and any name-change evidence. The standard non-REAL ID residency list requires at least one acceptable document; REAL ID requires two. At the DMV office, steps include payment, fingerprinting, a photo, vision screening and knowledge testing. Do not apply foreign-license road-test rules automatically or promise an individual test waiver.
外州车辆登记：20 天与驾照办理分开算: Out-of-state vehicle registration: its own 20-day clock
对迁入加州定居并带入外州已登记自用车的新居民，DMV 新居民页面要求在成为居民或: For new residents settling in California with their previously out-of-state-registered personal vehicle, DMV’s new-resident page requires registration within 20 days of becoming a resident or bringing the vehicle into California. Confirm the applicable trigger and exemptions; do not wait for a California license to arrive. Prepare signed REG 343, the latest out-of-state title and registration or acceptable alternatives, and authorized REG 31 vehicle verification. Leased or financed vehicles require attention to signatures and title handling. REG 343 accepts an out-of-state DL/ID number and issuing state if no California card has been issued. Smog requirements depend on the vehicle and exemptions. Vehicles driven or parked on California roads also need compliant financial responsibility and proof. Fees and taxes depend on the vehicle. Submit the application and fees on time even if title or smog documents remain outstanding.
已有加州记录的地址更新：另一个 10 天: Updating an existing California record: a separate 10 days
地址更新用于已有加州 DMV 记录：地址变化后 10 天内通知 DMV，不替代外: Notify DMV within 10 days of an address change on an existing California record. This does not replace an out-of-state license transfer or first California vehicle registration. Online Change of Address has eligibility rules: people without a California DL/ID or SSN cannot use that online process; check applicable alternatives such as mailing DMV 14. Have old and new addresses ready; add a vehicle to MyDMV Garage before updating it. Changing only the license or vehicle address does not automatically update the other, although both may be selected together. Processing can take up to three days and does not automatically issue new documents. First-time applicants should enter the correct address in their respective applications.
REAL ID 的身份与住址材料: Identity and residency documents for REAL ID
打开 DMV 的交互式 REAL ID Checklist，先选一种被接受的身份: Open DMV's interactive REAL ID Checklist, select an accepted identity document, and check whether name-change documents are needed. The address section requires two different printed documents showing the applicant's name and the California mailing address matching the application. Leases, bills, and other documents must meet the listed requirements; a screenshot is not automatically acceptable.
账单不是本人姓名时，官方清单对可使用的亲属关系证明另有说明，不能直接借室友账单代: If a bill is not in your name, the official checklist separately explains acceptable proof of family relationships; you cannot simply substitute a roommate's bill. Enter your SSN as required by the application. DMV's What Is REAL ID page describes possible exceptions, but not having received a number yet is not the same as qualifying for an exception. Confirm with DMV first. Even after uploading documents online, check which originals or certified copies you must bring in person.
材料条件不同时，查对应入口，不猜身份结论: When your documents differ, use the appropriate process instead of guessing eligibility
AB 60 是面向无法提供在美合法居留证明、但满足 DMV 其他条件并能证明身份: AB 60 is a separate driver's license path for applicants who cannot provide proof of lawful presence in the U.S. but meet DMV's other requirements and can prove identity and California residency. It is not the same as REAL ID. Check DMV's AB 60 page and dedicated checklist for documents and follow-up verification. DMV should also resolve other applicants' identity-document, expiration, or name-mismatch questions. Don't post passports, SSNs, or immigration documents publicly for strangers to review.
预约前，把文件夹和当天安排各检查一遍: Before your appointment, check both your document folder and the day's arrangements
已确认首次申请、换州、外国驾照、ID 或续补证的正确业务入口。: Confirm the correct process for a first application, out-of-state transfer, foreign license, ID, renewal, or replacement.
保留申请确认信息；预约地点、日期与业务类型互相一致。: Keep your application confirmation, and make sure the appointment location, date, and service type match.
身份与住址材料符合选定卡种清单，姓名拼写、单元号和邮寄地址一致。: Identity and address documents meet the checklist for your chosen card, with consistent name spelling, unit number, and mailing address.
需要知识考试时，使用 DMV 当前驾驶手册和官方练习资源准备。: If a knowledge test is required, prepare using DMV's current driver's handbook and official practice resources.
需要路考时，另核对预约、车辆、保险及陪同要求；持外国驾照者也不要默认可以独自往返: If a road test is needed, separately check appointment, vehicle, insurance, and accompanying-driver requirements. Foreign license holders should not assume they can drive to and from the test alone.
提前向 DMV 询问语言或无障碍协助；第三方翻译是否可参与，不能自行假设。: Ask DMV about language or accessibility assistance in advance. Do not assume a third-party interpreter may participate.
去之前先问清楚，结束后保存下一步: Ask before you go, and save your next steps afterward
把不确定项缩成两三个具体问题，例如“我申请普通 ID，这份地址文件是否符合要求”: Narrow uncertainties to two or three specific questions, such as "I'm applying for a standard ID; does this address document qualify?" That is more useful than only asking what to bring. After the visit, keep receipts, requests for additional documents, and follow-up links. A booked appointment, document pre-review, or completed test does not mean a final ID or license has been issued. Check current official information for fees and mailing progress.
